name: Duvo MCP
description: MCP surface for approved Duvo workspaces. Use it to expose Duvo runs, cases, approvals, and governed operational tools to compatible agents.
authentication: workspace bearer token or enterprise OAuth client credentials

tools.name: get_run
tools.description: Inspect run status, messages, tool calls, files, and audit events.

tools.name: create_case
tools.description: Create a durable queue case for an agent or specialist worker.

tools.name: respond_to_human_request
tools.description: Approve, reject, or answer a human approval request.
